subject: refresh cluster map in background (#531)
reason: The change adds one branch in ValkeySearch::OnServerCronCallback that refreshes the cluster map in the background, gated on IsCluster() && UsingCoordinator(). UsingCoordinator() is true only when the hidden, startup-only 'use-coordinator' config is set, and the only mechanism that sets it is the module load argument '--use-coordinator' placed after the module path on the loadmodule directive (the config is built Hidden() and ModuleConfigManager::Init never registers hidden entries with Valkey, so no CONFIG SET or config-file name for it exists). The fuzzer can only load modules by bare path: v
